summary: Completed testing of Pipeline Notifications feature for AnalytiCore. Fixed a critical bug in NotificationPreferenceSerializer missing pipeline fields. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI displays Pipeline Complete and Pipeline Failed toggles correctly in Notification Settings page.

bugs_fixed.issue: NotificationPreferenceSerializer was missing pipeline notification fields (email_on_pipeline_complete, email_on_pipeline_failed, push_on_pipeline_complete, push_on_pipeline_failed)
bugs_fixed.fix: Added missing fields to the serializer's fields list

passed_tests: All preference fields present (15 fields total)
Pipeline_complete notification exists from previous run
Pipeline notification has proper metadata (schedule_id, run_id, project_id, action_type, status)
Pipeline notification has related_object_type and related_object_id
Can mark pipeline notification as read
Notification preferences requires auth (401 without token)
Frontend - Notification Settings page loads correctly
Frontend - Pipeline Complete toggle visible with data-testid
Frontend - Pipeline Failed toggle visible with data-testid
Frontend - Notification bell dropdown shows pipeline notification
seed_data_creation: Tests use existing pipeline schedule and notifications from previous test runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pipeline notifications feature is fully functional. Backend APIs support: filtering notifications by type (pipeline_complete/pipeline_failed), updating preferences for pipeline notifications, creating notifications when pipelines run. Frontend NotificationSettings page at /settings/notifications shows Pipeline Complete and Pipeline Failed toggles in Email Notifications section with proper data-testid attributes. Notification bell dropdown on dashboard shows pipeline notifications. Note: Login route is /signin not /login.

backend_endpoints.get_preferences: GET /api/notifications/preferences - Returns all fields including pipeline ones

frontend_components.notification_bell_dropdown: Shows pipeline notifications with proper content

notification_creation.pipeline_complete: Created via send_pipeline_notification() in tasks.py when run.status='completed'
notification_creation.pipeline_failed: Created via send_pipeline_notification() in tasks.py when run.status='failed'
